interface.name: cp0_system_shell_v1
interface.description: This global is restricted by the compositor to the dedicated cp0-shell Unix account. It registers the trusted system surface and carries global system actions that must not depend on application keyboard focus.

entry.name: already_registered
entry.summary: a trusted surface is already registered

entry.name: invalid_surface
entry.summary: surface is not an eligible xdg desktop surface

request.name: register_surface

description.summary: register the trusted System Shell surface

request.description: The surface must belong to the authenticated client and use the os.cardputerzero.shell app-id.

request.name: set_visible

description.summary: show or hide the trusted system layer

request.description: A hidden System Shell remains alive but cannot be covered by an application when the compositor makes it visible for a system action.

request.name: activate_app
request.description: The token is allocated by the compositor and is valid only for the lifetime of the corresponding surface. Client-provided app-id strings are never used as authorization credentials.

description.summary: an application surface is no longer available

event.name: activation_failed

description.summary: an application token expired before activation

event.description: This is a normal lifecycle race, not a protocol violation. The Shell should remove the stale entry and remain connected.
